answer: As of FY2023, Amcor does not have an improving gross margin profile. Consolidated gross profit as a percentage of net sales decreased from 19.4% in FY2022 to 18.5% in FY2023. Gross profit itself decreased by $95 million (or 3%) from $2,820 million in FY2022 to $2,725 million in FY2023.
rationale: The gross profit percentage dropped from 19.4% in FY2022 to 18.5% in FY2023, and total gross profit decreased by $95 million, indicating a declining rather than improving gross margin profile.
